newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Intellect wins 80 pct of Techway.
newsitem.headline: Intellect wins 80 pct of Techway.

text.p: Software developer Intellect Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had 80 percent of computer company Techway Ltd and control of the board.
Intellect is offering one Intellect share for every 2.5 Techway shares plus five cents per Techway share. The offer closes on May 9.
The significant increase in Intellect's ownership was partly due to the acceptance by Nova Pacific Capital for its holding when its own 45 cents per share bid closed on April 27.
Techway shares were untraded but bid at 45.5 cents.
